thread:
Ava: Heads-up  noticed an odd drop in launch-post MQLs on the weekly KPI view during the webinar push (spike in sessions but fewer MQLs). Board: https://dash.redwood.ai/boards/launch-posts

Samir: Same. Quick triage shows a cluster of registrations with utm_campaign missing but referrer set to the webinar provider. Might be the redirect chain losing the querystring.

Rory: I pulled a sample and ran a simple check:
```sql
SELECT referrer, utm_campaign, COUNT(*) FROM registrations
WHERE created_at >= '2026-03-20' AND created_at < '2026-03-22'
GROUP BY referrer, utm_campaign;
```
NULL utm_campaign bucket ~270 rows, many with referrer like `https://events.comm/redirect?id=...`

ops-bot: FYI deploy infra/web-redirect@2026-03-18 added a 302 handler. Logs show several redirects without querystring forwarded for traffic from events.comm. https://logs.redwood.ai/redirects/1798

kpi-bot: Alert: cohort="spring-launch-2026" attribution-delta +31% vs baseline. See https://dash.redwood.ai/alerts/1798

Ava: Proposed immediate plan: 1) add a defensive ETL rule: parse campaign from referrer when utm missing, 2) add a dashboard note about the anomaly, 3) reprocess last 72h after fix. Keep SFDC imports paused during reprocess to avoid dupes.

Samir: I'll open a small ETL PR with: `campaign = COALESCE(utm_campaign, parse_referrer(referrer))` and include tests for typical event redirect patterns.

Rory: Can ops schedule a short pause on inbound CRM imports during the re-ingest window? @ops-bot

ops-bot: Request acknowledged. Will place a 25m pause on inbound imports starting after deploy+reprocess. Posting notice to #sales.

Ava: For the weekly KPI deck, I'll add an "Attribution note: event redirect" slide with before/after counts and the SQL used for triage. Also recommend standardizing on campaign-first ingestion in the KPI spec.

Samir: After reprocess I'll run `tools/compare_kpis --cohort spring-launch-2026 --window 72h` and paste CSV here. Will tag the reprocess with `reprocess-1798` so the ledger shows it.

Rory: Thanks  appreciate the quick turnaround. Let's huddle 30m post-deploy to confirm numbers. :thumbsup:
